## Body

#213 (lane B) at compaction: draft on main after #212, head 3c2b3330 with CI green. Local ab294f06 (spawn-rate hook attribution) is unpushed. The Claude live captures, the cost numbers and the scratch-HOME removal demo are still to do; full steps in the handover output for pr:213.

Claude Code 2.1.321, verified live:
- MessageDisplay hooks for consecutive flushes of one reply run CONCURRENTLY (flushes 0 and 1 started in the same ms). State one flush writes can miss the next, so a per-flush hook must order by `index` (`pij-rs hook claude-display` waits up to 1 s for flush i-1 via a state file with atomic rename). The prime's POC looked fine only because its block came in one flush. Test it with a timestamped wrapper; one green run proves nothing.
- Deltas are whole lines; the final flush may end mid-line, with `final: true`. An empty displayContent hides a flush. Output never reaches the model.
- Stop input is single-line JSON with last_assistant_message and stop_hook_active. The folder-trust prompt defaults to "No, exit": Down, then Enter.
- Project-level `.claude/settings.local.json` hooks merge with the user's, so a scratch folder can load a branch's hooks without touching ~/.claude. The user's Stop hook still runs too.

Copilot 1.0.109-0 SDK (`~/.copilot/pkg/<ver>/copilot-sdk/*.d.ts`; the HookType enum is in schemas/api.schema.json):
- onAgentStop carries no text. Take the last root `assistant.message` (no agentId) from session.on: it arrives 9-159 ms before the hook. The transcript file lags. Reset on user.message and abort; abort fires no onAgentStop.
- `{decision:"block", reason}` queues reason as the next user message; re-entry has stopHookActive. session.log lines never reach the model (checked against a positive control). There is no display hook; deltas need `streaming: true`.
- A project `.github/extensions/<name>` (symlink allowed) shadows the user-level extension of the same name, which is how to load a branch's extension in one scratch seat.

Rig hygiene: start a private tmux server with `env -i` and an allowlist. This shell carries PIJ_SESSION_ID, TMUX and COPILOT_*, and a leaked PIJ_SESSION_ID makes seats claim your identity. Give the private daemon a scratch HOME too, or its boot rewrites ~/.pij-rs and ~/.claude for every live Claude seat.
